decisions.reason: Pinpoints index.js:3 inject and index.js:9 ctx.apiProxy.llm.providers(), maps the break to A1-01, explains the target form inject:["llm"] + ctx.llm.listProviders() with face caveat, and explains the deleted/dangling dsh-host-apiproxy dependency requiring removal.

Each of the six other categories gets concrete scan patterns and file evidence; cordis.patch.yml is explicitly classified as composition overlay, not a source patch, and session-notes.js as an uncoupled utility, with no invented filename coupling.

§6 gives layered reasoning why zero hits cannot establish compatibility — heuristics not proofs, curated cards, dependency/manifest face outside the seven categories, differing evidence strength of negative kinds — while keeping the apiProxy break distinct from the negative categories.

§7 specifies syntax/type checks, dependency resolution gate, isolated-profile cold boot with dump-config showing no pending, a real listProviders() round-trip plus failure branch, and a negative control — all framed as to-be-executed, not run.
